patch_description: Instead of returning an empty arrangement, this program uses a deterministic seeded simulated-annealing optimizer. It starts from a structured initial configuration (vertices plus an interior grid/lattice layout inside the equilateral triangle), then repeatedly perturbs points, keeping moves that increase the minimum triangle area (computed vectorized over all C(11,3)=165 triplets) and accepting occasional downhill moves with a decaying temperature. Points are projected back into the triangle via barycentric coordinates after each move. This combines the lattice insight (good spread) with stochastic refinement (escaping local optima), yielding min areas typically near or above the benchmark of ~0.0365.
